title: Streamed HTML drawn as it arrives
blurb: Markup is streamed into an element in a canvas with streamAppendHTML(). Each chunk raises a paint event, and a shader draws the newest blocks through a scan line, a blur or spreading ink.
question: When markup is streamed into an element in a canvas, does the canvas get a paint event for each chunk, and can it draw the newest blocks differently from the rest?
result: In Chromium 157 each chunk raises one paint event with no call to requestPaint(). A MutationObserver gives the new blocks, and one shader pass draws them through an effect while the text stays selectable.
